what: a documented parser with ~20 spec rules and three visible tests
expectedOutcome: hidden PASS means every stated rule is implemented, not just the three the visible suite covers — the ordinary 'spec in prose, partial tests' situation
requirements: compound parts are accepted in descending unit order (d, h, m, s)
whitespace between parts and around the whole string is allowed
missing or unknown units are rejected with TypeError
out-of-order and repeated units are rejected
signed and fractional numbers are rejected
trailing garbage and interior garbage between parts are rejected
whitespace inside a part (between number and unit) is rejected
